title: Reset Password
content: Users can reset their password from Settings > Security > Password. After selecting Reset Password, the system sends a one-time verification code to the user's registered email address. The verification code expires after 10 minutes. Once the code is confirmed, the user can create a new password that is at least 12 characters long and includes a number and a special character.

title: Two-Factor Authentication
content: Two-factor authentication can be enabled from Settings > Security > Two-Factor Authentication. The platform supports authenticator apps and SMS codes. Recovery codes are generated during setup and should be stored safely. Administrators can require two-factor authentication for all team members from the Organization Security page.

title: Billing and Invoices
content: Billing details are managed from Account > Billing. Users with the Owner or Billing Admin role can update payment methods, change billing addresses, and download monthly invoices. Invoices are generated on the first day of each billing cycle and remain available for download for seven years.

title: Team Member Roles
content: The application includes four team roles: Owner, Admin, Editor, and Viewer. Owners can manage billing, security settings, and all users. Admins can invite users and configure workspaces. Editors can create and modify content. Viewers can read content but cannot make changes.

title: Data Export
content: Workspace data can be exported from Workspace Settings > Data Export. Exports include projects, tasks, comments, attachments metadata, and audit logs. Export files are prepared as ZIP archives and are available for 48 hours. Only Owners and Admins can request a full workspace export.

title: API Rate Limits
content: API requests are limited by plan. Free plans allow 60 requests per minute. Professional plans allow 600 requests per minute. Enterprise plans can request custom limits. When the rate limit is exceeded, the API returns HTTP 429 with a retry-after header that indicates when the client should try again.

title: Audit Logs
content: Audit logs record security and administrative events such as sign-ins, password changes, user invitations, role updates, billing changes, and export requests. Audit logs can be filtered by actor, event type, workspace, and date range. Enterprise customers can stream audit logs to external monitoring systems.

title: Support Escalation
content: Users can contact support from Help > Contact Support. Standard support replies within two business days. Priority support replies within four business hours. Critical production incidents should include the workspace ID, timestamp, affected users, screenshots if available, and steps to reproduce the issue.
